claims.statement: Within the inspected public UR interface, actual joint/TCP state is documented as controller output and no stock substitution input for actual_q at the native internal consumer is documented.
claims.domain: official public RTDE, Client Library and ROS 2 driver documentation retrieved 2026-10-11
claims.counterexample_or_limit: A vendor-only, research or later public pre-estimator splice would escape or refute this scoped result; undocumented absence is not asserted.

claims.statement: Cutting a ROS command controller cuts rho_cmd and does not discharge A4P P_block for the distinct native actual_q-to-internal-consumer route rho_int.
claims.domain: the route grains declared in A4Q
claims.counterexample_or_limit: If the selected target route were explicitly rho_cmd, the cut could test command contribution, but not anchor consumption merely from that fact.

claims.statement: A custom external controller that consumes RTDE actual_q and returns a reverse-interface command can define rho_ext, at whose actual_q argument same-consumer block and rescue are prospectively meaningful.
claims.domain: a future pinned composite robot-controller-PC bearer
claims.counterexample_or_limit: No custom consumer, hardware, external tracker or trial is installed here; success on rho_ext would not establish rho_int.

claims.statement: Single ROS command-interface ownership is weaker than A4P P_closed because it does not by itself inventory internal safety/scaling, URScript/native planning, external process, human/manual and physical disturbance paths.
claims.domain: the declared composite UR device boundary
claims.counterexample_or_limit: A complete pinned inventory plus negative controls could discharge P_closed for one event; no universal impossibility is claimed.

claims.statement: On the document-only evidence in A4Q, no actual token jointly discharges the eight A4P premises for rho_int or rho_ext; the correct status is NOT_INSTALLED.
claims.counterexample_or_limit: A future actual rho_ext package meeting every premise would overturn present noninstallation for that route only.
